task.summary: Datas are added for the project.

feat: build initial data processing pipeline and create Spark-ready data lake
Details:
Added raw CSV ingestion and created a cleaned processed dataset (dimuon_processed.parquet)
Performed feature engineering and generated ML-ready feature set (dimuon_features.parquet)
Implemented directory structure for project (data/raw, data/processed, data/features, docs, notebooks)
Created Spark-compatible partitioned data lake
spark/event_type=dimuon/energy=7/part-0000.parquet
Added exploratory analysis notebook with invariant mass histogram (J/ψ and Z peaks visible)
Prepared dataset for downstream ML anomaly detection and streaming pipeline

feat(data+ml): finalize dimuon ETL, feature set, spark partitions and anomaly scoring
Data Engineering: - structured data lake: raw → processed → features → spark partitions - saved processed dataset to parquet - generated partitioned layout event_type=dimuon/energy=7
Feature Engineering: - selected 11 physics-informed features for ML - exported ML-ready feature set to parquet
ML / Anomaly Detection: - trained autoencoder on dimuon feature space - computed anomaly_score and anomaly_label - visualized mass spectrum (normal vs anomaly)
Output: - saved final anomaly results parquet - code structured for next stage: anomaly analysis & model refinement

feat: add comprehensive anomaly analysis pipeline with physics-aware visualizations (pt/eta/mass), scatter plots, and PCA validation
This commit adds the full anomaly analysis step:
Loaded model outputs and separated normal vs anomaly sets
Implemented pt1, eta1, and invariant mass (M) distribution comparisons
Added pt1 vs M scatter plot to inspect multi-feature deviation
Added PCA 2D embedding for dimensionality reduction and anomaly separation
Verified that anomalies form clear clusters apart from normal muon events
Updated 03_anomaly_analysis.ipynb with structured workflow and explanations
This closes the analysis phase and provides strong visual + statistical evidence for meaningful anomaly detection in the dimuon dataset.
Implement PCA projection of AE anomalies and extend anomaly interpretation with reconstruction-error analysis.

Add full ensemble anomaly detection pipeline (IF + AE) with visual analysis
- Implement ensemble logic combining Isolation Forest and Autoencoder: - strong anomalies (IF ∩ AE) - IF-only anomalies - AE-only anomalies
- Generate full set of ensemble visualizations: - mass spectrum comparison - pt1 distribution comparison - PCA 2D embedding of ensemble groups
- Add PCA-based interpretation of anomaly groups - Clean dataframe merge issues and add pca1/pca2 columns - Prepare results for integration into final report
This commit completes the ensemble analysis stage of the project.
